method.method_draft: First inspect the figure: A, C, E lie on the same left slanted transversal, B, D, F lie on the same right slanted transversal, and the three cross segments AB, CD, EF are parallel. Read from the text that AB ∥ CD ∥ EF and AC/AE = 2/3. Apply the intercept theorem: parallel lines cut proportional corresponding segments on any two transversals, so the fraction of the distance from the top parallel to the bottom parallel is the same on both transversals. Therefore AC/AE = BD/BF, giving BD/BF = 2/3.
